summary: Verified efficientStepper/stepper return efficient-splitting steppers; length and knownSize use the documented Int.MaxValue cutoff; toFactory and all factory-shape members return the documented specialized or fallback factories; and the primitive-wrapper shapes store via the corresponding unboxed accumulators.

bonus_findings.issue: The pre-existing IntAccumulator implementation detail says every history array has one extra slot, but IntAccumulator reserves its final two slots for the high and low halves of the cumulative length.
bonus_findings.suggestion: Change “1 extra slot” to “2 extra slots” and retain the example explaining that 17 slots hold 15 elements.
